paragraphs.source_en: After his mother died, his father's concubine moved to Kudoyama on the pretext of caring for the younger children. She was the daughter of the warrior Hotta Sakubei, and her name was Yura. Daisuke even suspected that she was his own birth mother. Lady Yura had borne a son and a daughter, and with all the children romping around the house from morning to night, it had been a lively place.

paragraphs.source_en: At first, Daisuke had simply thought this was the natural frame of mind of a warrior before setting out for battle, but the more he considered it, the more something seemed amiss; the matter could not be so simple. Hideyori had secretly ordered his father to take the field, but escaping under the shogunate's close surveillance would be harder than climbing to heaven. His father's words therefore demanded careful thought.
